$comment: Reviewed Tauri command caps per Rust module (F-097). A new module may carry at most defaultMax commands; a module above it needs an entry here with a reason. Raise a cap only after deciding the module still owns one concern. Enforced by npm run check:modules; the rules live in scripts/rust-module-rules.mjs.

src-tauri/src/commands.rs.reason: Legacy Tauri file dialogs plus project open/save commands; split by concern before adding another.

src-tauri/src/package.rs.reason: Legacy package create/inspect/extract commands; split the module before adding a package command.

src-tauri/src/project_backup.rs.reason: Backup list, restore, replace and delete share one atomic backup path; splitting is a separate refactor.

src-tauri/src/project_lease.rs.reason: Acquire, release, heartbeat and inspect are one advisory-lock protocol and belong together.

src-tauri/src/project_write.rs.reason: Conditional write, metadata and round-trip check; an extraction is planned and no new command belongs here.

src-tauri/src/source_copy.rs.reason: Verified managed copy, source hash and folder checksum search; consolidate only through an extraction issue.

src-tauri/src/conflicted_copy.rs.reason: Conflicted-copy list and delete share one strict name parser and single-file delete guard.

src-tauri/src/smoke.rs.reason: Debug-only packaged smoke-test helpers share one result directory and exit path.

src-tauri/src/source_cleanup.rs.reason: Managed-copy inventory and batch removal share the same fresh reference check.
